0.original: Yubli is waiting on a shipment to arrive.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

25.original: Pick up the crate of goldwork.

26.original: Carry the crate of goldwork to the supply officer.

48.original: An important shipment has just arrived from Earthenshire, delivered to the nearest wharf by punutiy. The problem, however, is that the crate is <hex:021A020203>extremely<hex:021A020103> heavy.

49.original: I'd like to have it moved before arriving customers trip over it, but our Moblin porter appears to be struggling with the weight.

50.original: Could you go down to the wharf and lend a hand? The porter will tell you where the crate needs to be.

51.original: Special Advisor! Thank you for coming to handhelp floppyarm Mobbie!

52.original: Potsworn goldwork is a popular choice for Kozama'uka memorykeeping! But a crate holding many goldcrafts is too much bulkyweight for one Moblin to move. Please, he needs an ironarm adventurer to carry it to the supply officer!

53.original: Deliver the crate of goldwork to the supply officer waiting outside the travel agency storehouse before the time runs out.

54.original: You will have sixty seconds to complete the task. Should you fail, return to the starting location and begin anew.

55.original: That crate is too heavy for Mobbie, but the supply officer will be waiting! Please make the delivery with careful eyewatchings and quicksteps!

56.original: What's wrong? Was the crate too much bulkyweight even for you? Maybe you just need a shortrest before trying again!

57.original: Something else tickling your braincage? Mobbie is happy to leave the potsworn goldcraft in your capable helphands!

58.original: The goods we ordered should have been delivered by now...

59.original: Collect the Moblin porter's crate of goldwork from the wharf and deliver it to the supply officer.

60.original: Ah, is that the shipment from Earthenshire? Thank you for bringing it in. I would have picked it up myself, but sorting out our inventory has kept me chained to the storehouse.

61.original: Potsworn craft is in high demand, and maintaining a steady supply has been a logistical headache, to say the least. We've just had a customer asking about availability, so I'd like to get this goldwork on the shelves sooner rather than later.

62.original: Thank you for taking care of that delivery so quickly!

63.original: The potsworn's goldwork we sell in our shop is highly sought after by customers with more...expensive taste. It seems a memento like this becomes all the more special for having found it in such memorable surrounds.

64.original: Which is all to say that if we're not careful, our stock soon runs dangerously low. I'd be grateful if you could help out again should we need a hand!
